entity.name: ProjectBatch

many-to-many.name: projectSet
many-to-many.title: Projects
many-to-many.help: The selectable projects are those for which the 'Manage via project' option is enabled.

integer.name: toDoAnticipationDays
integer.title: To-do anticipation (days)
integer.help: Tasks whose due date falls within this number of days from today are notified as to do to their assignee.

integer.name: overdueLookbackDays
integer.title: Overdue lookback (days)
integer.help: Only tasks whose due date has passed within this number of days are notified as overdue. Older overdue tasks are ignored.

integer.name: overdueReminderFrequencyDays
integer.title: Overdue reminder frequency (days)
integer.help: Once notified as overdue, the assignee is reminded every N days while the task remains overdue. 0 disables reminders.
